verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions API versioning scheme, version numbers, or a documented deprecation policy for LangGraph's APIs; probe for OpenAPI spec even returned 404s. Community feedback (langgraph-comm-6) actually notes frequent breaking changes and poor documentation maintenance, but this alone doesn't meet the bar for 'disputed' since there's no explicit vendor claim of a versioning/deprecation policy to contradict — the axis simply has no supporting evidence.
